cases.name: Dinah Davis Northcutt
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Dinah went to Shelby County HS and attended the University of Alabama. She also studied Business Administration at the University of Montevallo. She was a former teacher at the Shelby County Chamber in Vincent, AL. She taught 2nd through 6th grade. She was a committed and faithful member of Metropolitan Church of God for 20 years."
cases.narrative: On 6/22/2022, during a welfare check, she was found stabbed to death.
